context.transcript:
Hi, my name is Tomoko.
I saw an advertisement for your motorcycle, and I'm interested in purchasing it, but I have a concern about the price. it's a little high considering it's a few years old.
Could you lower the price by 200 dollars?
I also read in the ad that you'd be willing to drop the motorcycle off at the buyer's house, but I live an hour away, so I don't want to make you drive too far.
My friend and I can come pick it up on Saturday if you accept my offer.
Give me a call back tonight at 555-0108.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，我叫 Tomoko。
我看到了您摩托车的广告，我对购买它感兴趣，但关于价格我有点担心。考虑到它已经有几年了，价格有点高。
你能把价格降低 200 美元吗？
我还从广告上看到您愿意将摩托车送到买家家里，但我离这里一个小时路程，所以我不希望让您开太远。
如果我提出我的报价，我和我的朋友周六可以来取。
今晚给我回电话，555-0108。
谢谢。
